messages:
ravi-peopleops: @ana-candidate quick thread to lock down logistics for your remote interview next Thursday. You mentioned you're in SGT and prefer a morning slot. Need to confirm exact time window, caption language (EN), any assistive tech, and whether you want a short connectivity test.

ana-candidate: Hi! Morning SGT is best. I can do 09:30-11:30 SGT. I use VoiceOver occasionally and would appreciate desktop screen-reader compatibility checks. Also prefer captions in English and a local Singapore dial-in if possible. A test call would be great.

marcus-hiringmgr: 09:30 SGT works for me. Loop length? I can do up to 80 minutes.

keiko-eng: I can join at 09:30. Prefer coding exercise in a shared editor; if VoiceOver causes issues we can switch to an oral design discussion. Happy to join a brief test call.

office-ops: I'll provision a local +65 dial-in and confirm that Redwood Zoom has Chrome accessibility features enabled. Also will add a note about allowing extra 10 minutes per block for breaks.

ravi-peopleops: Thanks. Can we do a 10-minute test call day before at 19:00 SGT to validate screen-reader + captions? Ana, does that time work?

ana-candidate: 19:00 SGT the day before works fine. Appreciate the accommodations.

calendar-bot: Draft invite created: "Interview  Ana (SWE)" 2026-08-12 09:30 SGT  Attendees: marcus-hiringmgr, keiko-eng, ravi-peopleops, ana-candidate. (Status: tentative)

ravi-peopleops: Please include in the invite: Zoom link, +65 dial-in, 15m prebrief for panel at 09:15 SGT, accessibility note: "Screen-reader friendly setup; captions ON; allow +10m per section; offer oral alternative for live coding if needed." Also include consent checkbox for transcript export.

keiko-eng: Prebrief agenda: 1) roles & time allocation 2) scoring rubric link 3) accessibility reminders 4) fallback: switch to oral design if screen-reader blocks editor.

marcus-hiringmgr: Rubric link please? I need to review examples for scoring.

ravi-peopleops: Rubric: https://redwood.company/sheets/interview-rubric. I'll paste the short scoring summary in the invite too.

office-ops: +65 dial-in set: +65 6123 4500 (PIN 2211). Zoom accessibility checked: captions + live transcript enabled by host. I'll attach a short accessibility checklist for interviewers.

keiko-eng: Noted. I'll be prepared to convert the pairing task into an oral design discussion if VoiceOver causes issues. Marcus, please keep 10 extra minutes per section in case Ana requests breaks.

ana-candidate: Thank you all. One question: can the transcript be shared after the interview? It helps me take notes.

ravi-peopleops: Yes we can export and share the transcript if you consent. We'll add a consent checkbox in the calendar invite.

calendar-bot: Test call scheduled: 2026-08-11 19:00 SGT (10 min) with ana-candidate, ravi-peopleops, office-ops. Interview prebrief scheduled: 2026-08-12 09:15 SGT.

office-ops: Quick note for interviewers: please use plain-text comments when sharing code for better screen-reader compatibility and avoid images-only diagrams. I'll attach a one-pager.

marcus-hiringmgr: All good from my side. Thanks for handling the accommodations.

ravi-peopleops: I'll flip the invite to confirmed once the panel confirms the prebrief and Marcus confirms the rubric review. Posting final here after confirmation. :white_check_mark:
